title: A PR knowledge gate only accepts candidates sourced from its own mission
summary: When a mission declares - Mission ID: in the PR Coordination section, the knowledge readiness gate requires at least one memory candidate whose source_ref matches that mission; promoted records carried over from a previous mission do not satisfy it. Run verify+distill on the PR mission before pr create, promote its own candidate into the branch, and declare it with a promoted: line.

expected_outcome: Observed on MSN-FOLLOWUP-UX-20261023: pr create failed with no_mission_candidates even though a promoted record from MSN-GOV-BROWSER was in the diff. The gate filters queue candidates by source_ref == the declared Mission ID. Fix path: verify → distill → memory-approve (product, pr_review) → memory-promote --target-root <worktree> → commit record → declare the candidate in ## Knowledge.
